column1: Stress testing provides an indication of the potential losses that could occur under extreme but plausible
market conditions, including where longer holding periods may be required to exit positions. Stress tests
comprise individual market risk factor testing, combinations of market factors per trading desk and
combinations of trading desks using a range of historical and hypothetical simulations. Daily losses
experienced during the year ended 31 December 2015 did not exceed the maximum tolerable losses as
represented by the Group’s stress scenario limits.
